2.note: CustomMessage type order_card with customData {card}; client editMessage(CustomMessage.setId) or server PUT /messages/{id}; onMessageEdited on the other side. REST customData edits unconfirmed: server sends metadata too and the adapter reads either

3.note: rule-based moderation in the dashboard (Contact Details Removal, Email Detection, custom regex list), action Block, all plans; getModerationStatus/onMessageModerated. Custom messages bypass moderation. Report: flagMessage on the target's latest message (modern) + our queue; report-user is a legacy extension only

4.note: native email (SendGrid or custom-provider webhook) and SMS through the Notifications platform; browser push via FCM_WEB

5.note: Message Translation extension (Build plan): sender-side callExtension v2/translate, stored in metadata['message-translation'] per the docs pattern; reader picks language. Falls back to our provider if the extension is off

6.note: addMembersToGroup(guid, [agent_sam as PARTICIPANT]); history fetched with MessagesRequestBuilder

7.note: markAsRead(message) + onMessagesRead receipts; startTyping/endTyping + onTypingStarted/Ended; MediaMessage(IMAGE) upload
